description: #764 phase 0: body-only edits seed enclosing-declaration anchors from the head checkout (Python method, Python function, TS class method, TS function, Go method); a module-level constant change seeds none. The anchors are the real change_anchors output for source_diff over repo_files (pinned by tests/test_change_anchors.py); both scanners search the high-confidence enclosing symbols and report callers outside the changed files.
